description.value: Creekside Market is a locally owned and operated full-service grocery store anchored in Whistler's Creekside Village since 1988, spanning 7,500 square feet of fresh produce, fine meats, seafood, a hot and cold deli, and artisan baked goods. It has been voted Whistler's Best Grocery Store in 2023 and 2024 and Best Customer Service four years running, making it a community institution for locals and visitors alike. Positioned at the base of Whistler Mountain in Creekside Village, it offers convenient one-stop resupply for touring cyclists moving through the Sea to Sky corridor.

address.value: #305-2071 Lake Placid Road, Whistler, BC, Canada
